title: PAUSE AND PRAY
AT NOON
end: The Midday Watch — pause and pray at noon
stock_queries: bright midday sun shining through a quiet empty room window
sunlight streaming across a calm wooden desk with an open journal
high noon sun over a peaceful open green field with no people
soft golden light filtering through linen curtains at midday
gentle sunbeams resting on a quiet empty wooden table
tranquil midday light illuminating a still room with green plants
bright peaceful afternoon light glowing across a calm landscape
soft sun rays shining into a quiet sanctuary at midday

scenes.a: Right now, wherever you are, gently pause whatever you are doing.
Take a slow, deep breath, and let the rush of the morning fade.
As the sun reaches its highest point in the sky, turn your heart toward the Lord.
Listen to the unchanging words found in Isaiah twenty-five, verse four.
For you have been a stronghold to the poor, a stronghold to the needy in his distress.
A shelter from the storm and a shade from the heat.
Lord, in the middle of our busy days, we rest beneath Your quiet shade.
Be our shelter, strengthen our hands, and grant us peace for the hours ahead.
